full_page.content:
c. 1903
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 9
Pg. 21 "Humiliation (fear of sore eyes etc) thanksgiving for same, June 12 & con- solation - on 13th 1902 - Maurice - after 17 yrs. speaks of returning to study.
1903 April 19th Singular dream & beautiful about Wm. N. his zeal even for others to go to confession.
Patroc S. Joseph (1903) Why observe so attentively what is not allowed to have - e.g. parvulos servos?
1903 May 15th Ipse mundus vanus est et vanitatis - praeteriens. Taedea nos Domie etiam eiusdem!
June 21 Today, for the 1st time in 7 years I heard about Rebecca. R.I.P. O queer world & uncertain! Deo gratias.
Pg. 22
1903 6/30 Papal Delegate Fr. Falconio O.M.
7/1 Election of Rev. P. Hieronimus Discr'te beautiful & edifying! Deo Gratias Ist time U. 8 votes: C. 11; H. 11 2nd time U. 2 votes: C. 8; H. 18
July 20th Today --- Death of His Holyn'ss Leo XIII 4:15 A.M. & Most Rev. F. Katzer 4:00 P.M. -- Tomorrow go to Holy Cross "I miss. "
Pope Pius X elected Aug. 5th the 7th ballot. Crowned Aug. 9th in presence of 70,000.
